verdict.rationale: The evidence pack holds only robots.txt probes, which show bot-challenge walls on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. None of it describes the published filing pages or any account-free or file-number entry path. A no-account entry path is a fair question for a state business-filing service, so the axis applies, but with no supporting evidence the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
